description.value: Your body operates on a much different rhythm than most ancestries. You don't need to sleep, but you still need a daily period of at least 4 hours of rest. During this period of rest, you must be physically inactive but remain conscious and aware of your surroundings. Much like with sleeping, if you go too long without resting, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fatigued] and can't recover until you rest for 4 hours. Because of your unusual relationship with sleep, you gain a +2 status bonus to saves against effects with the sleep trait.
